title: Tower Defense Kingdom: Idle TD Beginner Tips, 9 Ways to Win
subtitle: What to build, what to upgrade and what to check before each level.
description: Tower Defense Kingdom: Idle TD beginner tips: which towers to build first, what to upgrade, how to read the level info panel and how to earn stars and gems fast.
card: Nine beginner tips for Tower Defense Kingdom: Idle TD, which towers to build first, what to upgrade, how to use the level info panel, and how to save gold.

faq.q: What should I build first in Tower Defense Kingdom: Idle TD?
faq.a: Build one tower of each element if the level has room: fire, ice, lightning and earth. Mixed elements trigger combos, and having all four means you always have an answer for enemies that resist or ignore one element.

faq.q: Should I upgrade one tower or many?
faq.a: Spread your early upgrades over several towers, to about level 3 each. Combos need different elements to hit the same enemy, and fusion needs two towers with at least 3 stat levels each.

faq.q: How do I get three stars on a level?
faq.a: Finish the level with at least 90 percent of your lives left. With 20 lives that means losing no more than 2. Finishing with at least half your lives gives two stars, and any win gives one. Build combos early and keep the defence mixed.
